name: alakazam_ml_v18
model: The deck, LightGBM weights, features, and guarded ML scope are unchanged from v17. v18 adds deterministic legal-route planning for terminal attacks and Active-versus-Boss decisions.
model_scope: Live ML remains restricted to safe Abra/Dunsparce bench-role choice and same-evolution-card target choice. Attack, Energy, Trainer, Boss, Hammer, retreat, abilities, and END remain deterministic.
ml_override_environment: ALAKAZAM_ML_V18_ENABLE_OVERRIDE=0 disables the inherited guarded live scope; v17 and v15 flags remain compatibility fallbacks.

boss_route_failures.v17_action: Boss to a one-prize Riolu before Hammer

boss_route_failures.route: Enriching Energy + Alakazam evolution -> 340 HP Active KO
Dawn -> 440 HP Active KO -> game win

terminal_pivot_replay.finding: Run Away Draw was initially illegal under the opposing Stadium; after Stadium replacement the correct Dudunsparce pivot won, but optional setup actions were still interleaved.

v18_rule_changes: Enumerate only currently offered deterministic MAIN actions when projecting Powerful Hand damage.
Compare the final Active KO route against each Boss target and block a lower-prize Boss when the Active route is certain.
Treat Enhanced Hammer as a mandatory route action when it removes effect-prevention Energy.
Model guaranteed net hand gains from Alakazam/Kadabra evolution, Rare Candy, Enriching Energy, Dudunsparce, Dawn, and Hilda.
Attack immediately when an offered KO removes the opponent's final in-play Pokemon.
Use Active Dudunsparce immediately when Run Away Draw promotes a ready Alakazam for a board-wipe win.
Record Dudunsparce unavailable, declined, and terminal-pivot reasons separately.
known_limitations: v18 has not been submitted, so a public ladder rating improvement is not proven.
The route planner is intentionally conservative and ignores unknown top-decks or cards that are not currently legal options.
Post-KO attack continuity remains a measured problem, but the broad rebuilding rule failed its ablation and is not included.
The ranker was not retrained; the changes are deterministic tactical logic.
